title: Benchmarking Power Loss Simulation Models for Cracked Photovoltaic Cells Using Electroluminescence Images: The Effect of Daylight and Image Resolution
mechanism: Benchmarks an analytic (bELMO) and an ML (DTU) power-loss model for cracked cells across dark lab vs daylight EL and two camera resolutions.
adaptation: Benchmark protocol: severity errors reported per severity band; daylight / low-resolution as a robustness axis for WattCycle's future drone EL.
min_experiment: No training arm; adopt the per-band reporting in the severity protocol.
evidence: R: both models good for low-loss cells, error grows for severe cracks and high-irradiance daylight; bELMO lower average error.

alt_notes.adaptation: Design rule for our severity track: report error per severity band and per source. BMRK (downscaled ELPV) is our low-resolution case.
alt_notes.min_experiment: None. Design input: stratify severity metrics by band and by source.
